description: The City of Edmonton publishes the locations of fire stations throughout Edmonton. The documented fields include station name, address, latitude, longitude and point geometry. Additional fields relate locations to neighbourhood, ward and roadway-maintenance boundaries; some boundary labels explicitly refer to historical editions. The point inventory supplies emergency-service facility nodes for accessibility or response-area simulation with a suitable transport network. It does not establish staffing, equipment availability, vehicle travel times or dispatch policy. The descriptive metadata gives no positional accuracy or historical coverage interval. A current data-update timestamp does not establish the operational status of every station, and historical boundary fields should not be treated as current service-area definitions. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is See Terms of Use. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Edmonton.
